positive.query: Audit our software spend from these AP, corporate card and expense exports and tell me where we can cut SaaS costs.
Find unused licenses and duplicate tools across the apps in our SSO list and estimate what we could save.
Build a renewal calendar for our SaaS contracts with notice periods and auto-renew dates so we stop missing cancellation windows.

nearMiss.query: Compare three CRM vendors on features, pricing and support and recommend which one we should buy.
Our biggest vendor wants a 12% price increase at renewal; plan my negotiation strategy and walk-away point.
Answer this customer's security questionnaire about our data encryption and access controls.

holdout.query: Nobody owns half our tools; set up software ownership, an intake process for new apps, and a review cadence after the spend audit.

scenarios.task: A hypothetical 200-person company shares these facts: it pays for two video meeting tools and three project trackers; one design tool has 100 seats at 30 per seat per month with 55 users active in the last 90 days; 12 seats across tools belong to people who have left; the largest contract renews on 1 July with 60 days' notice and auto-renewal. Finance wants to cancel everything with low usage this week. Produce the audit and savings plan.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline recommends immediate cancellations, counts assigned seats as usage, presents savings as certain without formulas or realization dates, ignores notice deadlines, and skips data export, integration, and security checks.
